nodes.label: graphify skill
nodes.rationale: Turns any folder of files (code, docs, papers, images, video) into a persistent, queryable knowledge graph with honest EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS audit trail and community detection, so codebase questions can be answered from a graph instead of re-scanning files each time.

nodes.label: Fast path (existing graph.json check)
nodes.rationale: If graphify-out/graph.json already exists and the request is a natural-language question, skip rebuild steps 1-5 and jump straight to query - avoids redundant re-extraction cost.

nodes.label: Step 3: Structural + semantic extraction
nodes.rationale: Splits extraction into free deterministic AST parsing for code and LLM-based semantic extraction for docs/papers/images, run in parallel to save time; avoids requiring any Anthropic API key by using the host agent itself as the LLM when no Gemini key is set.

nodes.label: Shrink-guard on graph.json export
nodes.rationale: to_json() refuses to write a graph smaller than the existing one (issue #479), preventing an incomplete extraction from silently overwriting a good prior graph.

nodes.label: Step 4.5: Graph health check
nodes.rationale: Non-destructive diagnostic surfacing edge collapse, dangling/missing endpoints, and self-loops - the silent-corruption modes of incremental updates and AST/LLM id mismatches.

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge (use AMBIGUOUS if unsure), never skip corpus size warnings, always show token cost, never hide cohesion scores, warn before HTML viz on >5000 node graphs - keeps the audit trail trustworthy.

nodes.label: /graphify add <url>
nodes.rationale: Fetches a URL (YouTube/video, Twitter/X, arXiv, PDF, image, or generic webpage), saves it into ./raw with detected type-specific handling, then runs --update to merge it into the existing graph.

nodes.label: --watch folder watcher
nodes.rationale: Debounces file-change bursts (default 3s) so a wave of parallel agent writes doesn't trigger a rebuild per file; code changes rebuild automatically with no LLM, doc/image changes just flag needs_update for a manual --update.

nodes.label: graphify export neo4j / neo4j-push
nodes.rationale: Uses MERGE cypher statements so pushes are safe to re-run without creating duplicates.

nodes.label: graphify export falkordb / falkordb-push
nodes.rationale: FalkorDB's GRAPH.QUERY runs one statement at a time (no bulk cypher-shell import like Neo4j), so --falkordb-push is preferred over the static cypher.txt artifact for actually loading a graph.

nodes.label: MCP stdio server (graphify.serve)
nodes.rationale: Exposes query_graph, get_node, get_neighbors, get_community, god_nodes, graph_stats, shortest_path tools so other agents can query the graph live; Claude Desktop needs the absolute interpreter path since it can't run $(...) substitutions.

nodes.label: graphify benchmark (token reduction)
nodes.rationale: Only run when total_words > 5000 - for small corpora the graph's value is structural clarity, not token compression.

nodes.label: Extraction subagent prompt spec
nodes.rationale: Standardizes what each semantic-extraction subagent must output (JSON schema, node-ID rules, EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS confidence rubric) so chunked outputs merge cleanly without duplicate or orphan nodes.

nodes.label: Node ID format rule
nodes.rationale: IDs must use the full repo-relative path (every directory level) rather than just the immediate parent, so same-named files in different directories don't collide, and so IDs match deterministically between the AST extractor and LLM subagents (avoiding orphan ghost-duplicate nodes).

nodes.label: Confidence score rubric (0.55-0.95 discrete steps)
nodes.rationale: Discrete rubric values chosen because models follow discrete rubrics better than continuous ranges; production data showed continuous guidance collapsing to a bimodal distribution (>50% at 0.5, >40% at 0.85+), so 0.5 was removed as an option entirely.

nodes.label: graphify merge-graphs (cross-repo/monorepo)
nodes.rationale: Running the skill pipeline separately on each monorepo subfolder would clobber a shared graphify-out/ dir, so each subfolder is extracted independently (graphify-out placed inside the scanned path) and then merged at the project root; merged nodes carry a repo attribute for provenance filtering.

nodes.label: graphify hook install (post-commit auto-rebuild)
nodes.rationale: Triggers once per commit rather than running a background process; only re-runs AST extraction on changed code files, ignoring doc/image changes which still need a manual --update.

nodes.label: graphify claude install (native CLAUDE.md integration)
nodes.rationale: Writes a persistent ## graphify section into the project's CLAUDE.md so Claude Code always checks the graph before answering codebase questions and rebuilds it after code changes, without needing manual /graphify invocation each session.

nodes.label: Constrained query vocabulary expansion (Step 0)
nodes.rationale: graphify query matches nodes via case-folded substring + IDF with no stemming/synonyms/cross-language support, so a literal mismatch between user wording and graph labels (different language, different domain vocabulary) collapses results to noise; expanding the query against the graph's own extracted label vocabulary first (never inventing tokens) fixes this without hallucinating matches.

nodes.label: BFS/DFS traversal modes
nodes.rationale: BFS (default) is best for broad 'what is X connected to' context; DFS (--dfs) traces one specific chain/dependency path as deep as possible before backtracking.

nodes.label: save-result / reflect work-memory loop
nodes.rationale: Answers are saved back into the graph with an --outcome (useful/dead_end/corrected) tag so future sessions get preferred sources, skip known dead ends, and see prior corrections via LESSONS.md - a self-improving feedback loop across sessions.

nodes.label: Whisper transcription for video/audio
nodes.rationale: The host agent itself composes a one-sentence domain-hint prompt from existing god-node labels (no separate API call needed) and passes it to Whisper as the initial prompt to improve transcription quality for the corpus's specific vocabulary.

nodes.label: --update incremental re-extraction
nodes.rationale: Only re-extracts changed/new files (saves tokens and time); code-only changes skip semantic extraction (Step 3B) entirely since AST alone suffices; build_merge preserves edge direction and only prunes genuinely deleted files' nodes, since replace-on-re-extract already reconciles changed files.

nodes.label: --cluster-only reclustering
nodes.rationale: Self-contained: re-clusters and regenerates GRAPH_REPORT.md/graph.json/graph.html from the existing graph without needing intermediate files that a prior build's cleanup already deleted.

nodes.label: Module DOTTEL - Dotations Téléphoniques Mensuelles (AFRILAND HORIZON 2030)
nodes.rationale: Digitalizes Afriland First Bank's manual paper-based monthly phone-dotation payment circuit into a multi-level electronic workflow integrated with the BAOBAB platform; design already fixed upstream so implementation must not invent business rules.
nodes.norm_label: module dottel - dotations telephoniques mensuelles (afriland horizon 2030)

nodes.label: Stack technique V3 (Spring Boot 4.1.0 / Java 21 / React 19 / PostgreSQL 16)
nodes.rationale: Fixed stack decisions: no React Query (Context API for auth, useState for the rest), no Client Extension Liferay for BAOBAB integration, no service registry/gateway - deliberately deferred until DSI mandates one.
nodes.norm_label: stack technique v3 (spring boot 4.1.0 / java 21 / react 19 / postgresql 16)

nodes.label: grille_tarifaire table (tariff grid)
nodes.rationale: Partial unique constraint enforces only one ACTIVE grid without date_fin per function at a time; ARH creates a BROUILLON grid, submits to DRH (EN_ATTENTE_DRH), DRH validates or rejects - id_createur/id_validateur nullable specifically to allow Flyway V2 seed data with no real user reference.

nodes.label: ligne_etat_mensuel (pivot table)
nodes.rationale: Mandatory N-N pivot between processus_mensuel and beneficiaires - never a direct @ManyToMany - because it carries the per-month montant/fonction which can be adjusted by ARH and differ from the beneficiary's current values.

nodes.label: piece_jointe (single PDF per process)
nodes.rationale: UNIQUE(id_processus) - exactly one document per process, enriched progressively (1 to 3 signatures) rather than three separate PDFs, per RG-06.

nodes.label: 25 fonctions éligibles (NS 69/17 + 3 corps assimilés)
nodes.rationale: 22 posts from Note de service NS 69/17 plus 3 business-added corps assimilés (CONTROLEUR_GESTION, CONTROLEUR_COMPTABLE, COMPTABLE) validated by the responsable métier, totalling 25 eligible functions.

nodes.label: JURISTE code = "Agent de Recouvrement" label decision
nodes.rationale: Confirmed by the responsable métier on 15 July 2026: JURISTE is post n°20 of NS 69/17 (35,000 FCFA) and is the only post currently considered an agent de recouvrement, despite the code name mismatch with its libellé.
nodes.norm_label: juriste code = "agent de recouvrement" label decision

nodes.label: 5 énumérations (StatutEnum, RoleEnum, NomEtapeEnum, StatutEtapeEnum, StatutGrilleEnum)
nodes.rationale: FonctionEnum and TypeDocumentEnum deliberately do not exist - eligible functions are data-driven via fonction_eligible/grille_tarifaire, not hardcoded enums, so business changes don't require code changes.

nodes.label: RG-01: Éligibilité par fonction_eligible.actif
nodes.rationale: Replaces a fixed enum-based eligibility check with a data table check, so the system is no longer limited to a fixed subset; unknown/inactive functions are refused with NON ELIGIBLE.

nodes.label: RG-02: Grade check for corps de contrôle et assimilés
nodes.rationale: Only 5 functions (CORPS_CONTROLE_IG/IGA, CONTROLEUR_GESTION, CONTROLEUR_COMPTABLE, COMPTABLE) require grade != NON GRADE for eligibility; all other functions skip the grade check entirely.
nodes.norm_label: rg-02: grade check for corps de controle et assimiles

nodes.label: RG-04: Montant from grille_tarifaire only, never hardcoded
nodes.rationale: Amount must be resolved by querying grille_tarifaire (ACTIVE, date_fin IS NULL) for the employee's function - never a hardcoded Java value - so tariff changes never require a code deploy.
nodes.norm_label: rg-04: montant from grille_tarifaire only, never hardcoded

nodes.label: RG-06: Single PDF per process, enriched via signatures
nodes.rationale: DocumentService.genererInitiale() at ARH validation, then ajouterSignature() at CRH and DRH validation - nombre_signatures counter goes 1 to 3 on the same file, never three distinct files.
nodes.norm_label: rg-06: single pdf per process, enriched via signatures

nodes.label: RG-08: Separation of duties (SeparationTachesService)
nodes.rationale: The actor validating a step cannot be the same one who validated the previous step - checked in SeparationTachesService, returns 403 on violation.

nodes.label: RG-09: Historisation via audit_log delta JSON
nodes.rationale: Every business attribute modification must be traced with a before/after JSON delta in audit_log.detail_json, format {"avant":{...},"apres":{...}} - called via AuditService.enregistrer().
nodes.norm_label: rg-09: historisation via audit_log delta json

nodes.label: RG-10: Tariff grid ARH/DRH validation workflow
nodes.rationale: Every ARH-created/modified grid goes to EN_ATTENTE_DRH; DRH validates or rejects; on validation the old ACTIVE grid's date_fin is set and the new one becomes ACTIVE - system prevents two ACTIVE grids without date_fin for the same function.
nodes.norm_label: rg-10: tariff grid arh/drh validation workflow

nodes.label: RG-11: Excel import with per-row validation and report
nodes.rationale: Invalid rows (duplicate matricule, unknown function, missing fields) are rejected and listed in an import report; valid rows are still inserted even if other rows fail - partial success by design.
nodes.norm_label: rg-11: excel import with per-row validation and report

nodes.label: Déploiement Kubernetes (Section 14, V3 new)
nodes.rationale: DSI manager confirmed DOTTEL is a containerized microservice orchestrated by Kubernetes (not a manual Harbor image push); deliberately no service registry/API gateway (no Eureka/Consul) yet - each BAOBAB module exposed via its own K8s Service/URL, to be reevaluated only if DSI later mandates a centralized gateway.

nodes.label: Ordre d'implémentation des sprints (V3, Sprint 0 to 7 + 4bis + 6F)
nodes.rationale: V3 adds containerization to Sprint 0 and a dedicated Sprint 6F for the full frontend, and RG-11 Excel import moves earlier into Sprint 2/4 compared to V2's later placement.
nodes.norm_label: ordre d'implementation des sprints (v3, sprint 0 to 7 + 4bis + 6f)

nodes.label: Données de test camerounaises (convention obligatoire)
nodes.rationale: All stub/test/Postman data must use realistic Cameroonian names (MBARGA, ESSAMA, NKOLO, ATANGANA...) and cities (Douala, Yaoundé, Bafoussam...) instead of generic placeholders like John Doe/Test User/Foo Bar - added explicitly in V3 as error #17 to never commit.

nodes.label: Module DOTTEL V2 (Dictionnaire de données/contrats API V2)
nodes.norm_label: module dottel v2 (dictionnaire de donnees/contrats api v2)

nodes.label: 24/25 fonctions éligibles (V2, NS 69/17 + enrichissement métier)
nodes.rationale: V2's section title says '24 FONCTIONS' but lists the same 25 rows as V3 (22 from NS69/17 + 3 corps assimilés); V2 lacks the JURISTE naming rationale and the 15 July 2026 confirmation note present in V3.

nodes.label: grille_tarifaire table (V2)
nodes.rationale: V2's id_createur FK is non-nullable (vers utilisateurs) while V3 makes both id_createur and id_validateur nullable specifically to allow Flyway V2 seed insertion without a real user reference - a schema refinement between versions.

nodes.label: Contrats API V2 - 26 endpoints (fonctions/ instead of grilles-tarifaires/)
nodes.rationale: V2 Groupe 7 endpoints are named /fonctions, /fonctions/{id}, /fonctions/{id}/valider, /fonctions/{id}/historique; V3 renames the whole group to /grilles-tarifaires/... - clarifying that the resource being managed is the tariff grid, not the function itself.
nodes.norm_label: contrats api v2 - 26 endpoints (fonctions/ instead of grilles-tarifaires/)

nodes.label: Ordre d'implémentation des sprints (V2, Sprint 0 to 7)
nodes.norm_label: ordre d'implementation des sprints (v2, sprint 0 to 7)

nodes.label: No Kubernetes/deployment section in V2
nodes.rationale: V2 has 17 top-level sections ending at 'Charte visuelle frontend' with no deployment/infrastructure section; V3 inserts a new Section 14 'Déploiement et infrastructure' formalizing the DSI's Kubernetes decision, pushing later sections down by one and adding error #17/#18 about test data and service registry/gateway.
